title: Valencia Crush Barca to Win the Second Liga Title in Their History
description: Valencia Basket are champions of Spain. The Taronja produced a commanding 108-84 win at the Palau Blaugrana to close out the Liga Endesa finals 3-1 and lift the second league title in the club's history, the crowning moment of a superb season. Widely regarded as the best team in Europe over the course of the campaign, Valencia simply overwhelmed Barca with their physicality, intensity and shooting. Pedro Martinez's side took control with another irresistible display from Jean Montero (188-PG-2003), who finished with 23 points, three assists and two rebounds, superbly complemented by Kameron Taylor (198-SF-1994, college: Seton Hill) (21 points, six rebounds) and the marksmanship of Omari Moore (198-SG-2000, college: SJSU) (19 points on 4-of-6 from three).
